slots.title: Five places your *leads* leak
slots.body: Good businesses lose work in the gap between an enquiry and a reply. Here are the five gaps to check.

slots.title: The *slow* reply
slots.body: While the enquiry waits for an answer, the customer is free to ask someone else.
points: Ask: how long did your last reply take?
Fix: a fast first reply, even a short one

slots.title: The *missed* call
slots.body: The phone rings out while you're on a job. A caller who doesn't leave a message is hard to win back.
points: Ask: how many calls went unanswered last week?
Fix: every call answered or called back

slots.title: No *follow-up*
slots.body: A quote goes out, then silence. Without a follow-up, the enquiry quietly goes cold.
points: Ask: who follows up, and when?
Fix: a simple follow-up plan for every quote

slots.title: No easy way to *book*
slots.body: Interested people are ready to pick a time. If they can't, the back-and-forth starts.
points: Ask: can someone book without calling you?
Fix: offer real times in the first reply

slots.title: After-hours *silence*
slots.body: Enquiries arrive at night and on weekends. Silence until Monday can feel like a no.
points: Ask: what happens to a 9 pm enquiry?
Fix: an instant, honest reply out of hours

slots.title: One *front office* for all five
slots.body: VENTRA's AI Receptionist and AI Setter are built to close these gaps. Both are in sandbox testing; launching soon.
